meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 会像高端设计机构一样输出代码，使用特定字体、间距、阴影和动画，避免常见廉价设计模式。
howto.when: 当你要求生成网页 UI 代码时触发，尤其是需要高端视觉风格时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的着陆页，用玻璃态风格。
创建一个奢侈品品牌的首页，用编辑式布局。

howto.what_en: Claude will output code like a high-end design agency, using specific fonts, spacing, shadows, and animations, avoiding common cheap design patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate web UI code, especially when a premium visual style is needed.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a SaaS product using glassmorphism style.
say_en.note: Claude will apply Ethereal Glass vibe and double-bezel architecture.

say_en.text: Create a homepage for a luxury brand with an editorial layout.
say_en.note: Claude will choose Editorial Luxury texture and Editorial Split layout.
